'''Daishōgun Shrine''' (大将軍神社, Daishōgun Jinja)
Daishōgun Shrine, also referred to as Daishōgun Sha (大将軍社), is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} dedicated to {{ill|Daishōgun (deity)|ja|大将軍 (方位神)|lt=Daishōgun}}, the god of directions. Many of these shrines originally enshrined Daishōgun, but underwent {{ill|Changes to deities in the Meiji period|ja|祭神の変更}} during the Meiji era.
* {{ill|Daishōgun Hachiman Shrine|ja|大将軍八神社|qid=Q11434526}} – Located in [[Kamigyō Ward]], [[:en:Kyoto City|Kyoto City]], at {{ill|Nishimachi (Kyoto)|ja|西町 (京都市上京区)}} on [[Ichijō Street]]. 
** Nearby: {{ill|Ichijō Street Daishōgun Shopping District|ja|一条商店街}} (known as the Daishōgun Shopping Street and Ichijō Yōkai Street)<ref>[https://kanko.city.kyoto.lg.jp/detail.php?InforKindCode=1&ManageCode=12000011 Kyoto City Tourism Guide]</ref>.
* {{ill|Daishōgun Shrine (Moriyama)|ja|大将軍神社 (守山市)}} – Located in [[:en:Moriyama|Moriyama]], {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|en|Shiga Prefecture|qid=Q131358|lt=Shiga Prefecture}}, in {{ill|Furutaka (Moriyama)|ja|古高 (守山市)}}.
* {{ill|Daishōgun Shrine (Kita-ku, Kyoto)|ja|大将軍神社 (京都市北区)}} – Located in [[Kita Ward (Kyoto City)|Kita Ward]], Kyoto, in {{ill|Nishigamo|ja|西賀茂|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishigamo|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q109360544}}, often called Nishigamo Daishōgun Shrine.
